:::{#def-wald-ci}
#### Wald confidence interval

The approximate $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ **Wald confidence interval**
for the $k$th entry $\param_k$ of a parameter vector is

$$
\hparam_k \pm z_{1 - \siglevel/2} \times \HSE{\hparam_k}
$$

where $\hparam_k$ is the $k$th entry of $\hthml$,
$\HSE{\hparam_k}$ is its estimated standard error,
and $z_{\quantlevel}$ is the $\quantlevel$ quantile of the standard Gaussian distribution.
:::
